name: Tropical Rainforest Heritage of Sumatra
description: This vast stretch of rainforest on the island of Sumatra, Indonesia, spans 2.5 million hectares across three national parks: Gunung Leuser, Kerinci Seblat and Bukit Barisan Selatan. It shelters around 10,000 plant species, more than 200 mammal species and some 580 bird species, including the Sumatran orang-utan. Poaching, illegal logging and farming have put it on the List of World Heritage in Danger since 2011.
